alreadyObserved: The primary paper, official RADAR record, archive manifest, configuration CSV files, cell overview workbook, and data-structure workbook were inspected.
The paper reports aggregate cohort design and confirms repeated standardized room-temperature check-ups; those published summaries were visible before sealing.
Configuration inspection established 228 cells in 76 triplicate conditions, with exactly 57 cells at each of 0, 10, 25, and 40 degrees Celsius.
Column definitions revealed the available capacity, EIS reference impedance, pulse resistance, timestamp, check-up number, and validity fields.
notYetObservedAtSeal: No value from cell_eocv2.zip, cell_eisv2.zip, or cell_plsv2.zip was read.
No cell-level capacity, impedance, resistance, event time, censoring time, prediction, error, or hypothesis verdict was computed.
No pilot, development, or target outcome informed the split, features, model, thresholds, or decision rules.

selection.reason: RC52 rejected a static early-cycle passport across sources, and RC53 found that a static electrode-resistance passport did not improve a common-horizon response. The KIT HG2 study supplies a same-purchase-batch cohort, 76 triplicate stress conditions, repeated capacity/EIS/pulse check-ups, and a continuation to roughly 600 days. A complete 40-degree holdout can therefore test whether an early within-cell perturbation response transfers to a genuine 80%-capacity EOL endpoint.
selection.claimBoundary: RC54 tests a same-cell-model, held-temperature EOL bridge. It cannot establish chemistry transfer, pack-level RUL, field duty-cycle transfer, failure safety, or a universal digital twin.
selection.deferredScope: Cyber-trust experiments, new battery cycling, cell opening, destructive analysis, field packs, warranty decisions, and safety certification remain outside scope.

sourceManifest.versionScope: Processed result data for nearly 600 days; the primary paper described version 1 through 449 days.
sourceManifest.cohort: 228 cells from one purchased batch, assigned to 76 conditions with three cells per condition

cohortRule: Include every non-P000 configuration with cell_used equal to one.
Require a resolvable CU0 and CU1 standardized room-temperature capacity record and the registered EIS and pulse summaries for arm D.
Require a positive landmark-to-last-check-up duration; define an event only from the first standardized capacity check-up at or below the registered 80% threshold.
Do not remove a cell because its response, prediction, residual, or degradation path is extreme.
Report feature completeness and event coverage before fitting; a missing registered quantity is not outcome-aware imputed.

pilot.coverage: One calendar cell, one symmetric low-rate cyclic cell, one voltage-window/asymmetric cyclic cell, and one WLTP-profile cell, all outside 40 degrees Celsius.
pilot.use: Exact archive path, delimiter, check-up identity, room-temperature flag, SOC identity, units, sign, validity, and duplicate-row aggregation only.
pilot.permittedAmendment: Before any non-pilot result row is read, one dated amendment may map exact columns and row keys to the quantities already registered here or declare a quantity unavailable. It may not change the split, endpoint, feature meaning, model, alpha, thresholds, or hypotheses.

untouchedTarget.reason: Every 40-degree cell is withheld as a temperature-extrapolation test. No target feature or endpoint contributes to preprocessing, fitting, feature choice, model choice, threshold choice, or recalibration.

endpointContract.landmark: The timestamp of the second standardized room-temperature check-up, CU1, approximately one week after CU0.
endpointContract.capacityReference: The same cell's finite room-temperature cap_aged_est_Ah at CU0.
endpointContract.event: The first later standardized room-temperature check-up whose cap_aged_est_Ah is at most 0.80 times the CU0 reference.
endpointContract.eventTime: Elapsed days from the CU1 landmark to that first observed threshold-crossing check-up.
endpointContract.censorTime: If no crossing is observed, elapsed days from CU1 to the last later standardized room-temperature capacity check-up.
endpointContract.resolution: No interpolation between check-ups. Event times retain the study's approximately three-week assessment interval.
endpointContract.primaryErrorCohort: Target cells with observed events; all target cells, including censored cells, enter concordance and calibration metrics.
endpointContract.prohibitedInterpretation: An observed check-up crossing is interval-resolved electrochemical EOL, not a failure timestamp, safety event, warranty outcome, or pack RUL.

stressArm.definition: Configuration-known stress only. Inverse temperature is 1/(T_C+273.15)-1/298.15.

staticDiagnosticArm.definition: A static room-temperature electrochemical passport at CU0.

capacityResponseArm.definition: log(CU1 capacity/CU0 capacity) divided by elapsed days between CU0 and CU1.

perturbationResponseArm.definition: For each positive EIS or pulse quantity Q, log(Q_CU1/Q_CU0) divided by its exact elapsed days. This tests a multiscale impedance-response fingerprint rather than another static level.

rowRules: Use source rows marked as room-temperature check-ups and, for EIS, valid rows only.
Select nominal SOC values 10, 30, 50, 70, and 90 percent exactly as represented in the source.
If duplicate valid summaries exist for one cell, check-up, and SOC, aggregate by the median before forming a feature.
Require every logarithm input to be finite and strictly positive.
featureContract.preprocessing: For each arm, subtract the non-pilot development mean and divide by the non-pilot development population standard deviation. Replace an exactly zero development standard deviation with one. Pilot and target rows have zero influence.
featureContract.missingness: No outcome-aware imputation, target-derived centering, feature clipping, or feature substitution is allowed. Report exact arm denominators and missing fields.

modelContract.model: Separate penalized Weibull accelerated-failure-time model for each nested arm. log(lambda_i)=intercept+x_i beta; the Weibull shape k is shared within an arm.
modelContract.likelihood: Use the right-censored Weibull likelihood with observed event/censor time measured from CU1. Penalize beta, but not the intercept or log(k), by fixed L2 alpha 1.0.
modelContract.initialization: Intercept equals log of the development median observed-or-censor time, beta is zero, and log(k)=log(2).
modelContract.optimizer: Primary Python uses deterministic BFGS with analytic likelihood evaluation; independent dependency-free Node uses a separately written deterministic BFGS implementation. No hyperparameter search, target calibration, feature selection, ensemble, or early stopping based on target performance.
modelContract.prediction: Predicted remaining median days equals lambda_i times (log 2)^(1/k). Predicted survival at horizon t equals exp(-(t/lambda_i)^k).
modelContract.independentTolerance: Absolute disagreement at most 1e-5 for every target prediction and reported scalar metric; arm verdicts must match exactly.

metricContract.ranking: Harrell concordance over all target cells; a pair is comparable when the shorter observed time is an event. Tied prediction receives half credit.
metricContract.withinConditionRanking: The same concordance rule restricted to pairs within each three-cell P-condition; report the comparable-pair denominator.
metricContract.familyBoundary: For calendar, cyclic, and profile target cells separately, report event count and median absolute error among observed events.
metricContract.calibration: At 365 and 500 days after CU1, compare mean predicted survival with target Kaplan-Meier survival; report absolute error and the at-risk count.
metricContract.pairedImprovement: For event-observed target cells, report (baseline MdAE-D MdAE)/baseline MdAE. Use 2,000 seeded cluster-bootstrap resamples of the 19 target conditions to report a percentile 95% interval for D-versus-C MdAE change; the interval is descriptive, not a hidden tuning gate.
metricContract.reporting: Publish every target prediction, censor flag, condition, family, and every registered metric even when a gate fails.

competingHypotheses.claim: Imposed stress descriptors alone transport sufficiently from 0/10/25 to 40 degrees Celsius.
competingHypotheses.success: Arm A has at least 30 target events, event MdAE at most 75 days, Harrell concordance at least 0.70, maximum 365/500-day calibration error at most 0.15, and no family MdAE above 105 days.

competingHypotheses.claim: The static CU0 capacity/EIS/pulse passport adds transferable cell information beyond stress.
competingHypotheses.success: Arm B reduces event MdAE by at least 10% relative to A without reducing Harrell concordance by more than 0.02 and without increasing the worst family MdAE.
competingHypotheses.reject: Reject unless all three conditions hold.

competingHypotheses.claim: The one-week capacity response carries transferable susceptibility information beyond the static passport.
competingHypotheses.success: Arm C reduces event MdAE by at least 15% relative to B, does not reduce Harrell concordance by more than 0.02, and does not increase maximum calibration error.
competingHypotheses.reject: Reject unless all three conditions hold.

competingHypotheses.claim: A multiscale one-week EIS/pulse response supplies the missing bridge to held-temperature EOL.
competingHypotheses.success: Arm D has complete target features, at least 30 target events, event MdAE at most 60 days, at least 10% MdAE improvement over C, Harrell concordance at least 0.72, within-condition concordance at least 0.60 over at least 30 comparable pairs, no family MdAE above 90 days, maximum 365/500-day calibration error at most 0.15, and independent adjudication within tolerance.
competingHypotheses.reject: Reject if any boundary fails; pooled error alone cannot rescue a failure of within-condition ranking, family transport, calibration, coverage, or independent reproduction.

causalChain: Known stress and standardized CU0/CU1 electrochemical measurements
latent cell susceptibility that a static level may confound with batch and protocol
the registered within-cell logarithmic response rates as a proposed bridge
independently withheld 40-degree EOL time, censoring, calibration, and triplicate ordering
retain or reject the response fingerprint as a candidate same-chemistry EOL bridge
fastFailureTests: If the three result archives fail their registered MD5 hashes, stop before extraction.
If a pilot cannot identify CU0/CU1, room-temperature rows, exact SOC, or positive registered quantities without outcome-dependent judgment, stop or declare the affected arm unavailable.
If fewer than 30 target cells have observed 80% EOL events, H0 and H3 fail the coverage gate; report survival metrics without claiming a decisive EOL bridge.
If fewer than 30 within-condition target pairs are comparable, H3 fails even if pooled concordance is high.
If Python and Node disagree beyond 1e-5, stop interpretation and debug before publication.

uncertaintyBudget.control: Use standardized room-temperature check-ups, source validity flags, exact SOC, median duplicate aggregation, and source units.
uncertaintyBudget.residual: Capacity EOL is interval observed and EIS/pulse summaries may retain fixture or temperature history effects.
uncertaintyBudget.stop: Unresolvable check-up/SOC identity or nonpositive response inputs make the affected arm non-computable.

uncertaintyBudget.control: Freeze nested feature sets, Weibull AFT form, alpha, initialization, and metrics before results; reproduce with a separate runtime.
uncertaintyBudget.residual: A single Weibull shape and linear log-scale relation may be misspecified.
uncertaintyBudget.stop: Optimization failure, nonfinite parameters, or independent disagreement blocks a verdict.

uncertaintyBudget.control: Hold out all 57 cells and 19 triplicate conditions at 40 degrees; bootstrap by condition rather than by row.
uncertaintyBudget.residual: All cells share one model and purchase batch, and temperature is extrapolated rather than replicated across laboratories.
uncertaintyBudget.stop: Do not generalize beyond this HG2 cohort or call the result chemistry transfer.

uncertaintyBudget.control: Use a preregistered 80%-of-own-CU0 crossing, preserve right censoring, and avoid interpolation.
uncertaintyBudget.residual: Approximately three-week check-up spacing limits event-time resolution.
uncertaintyBudget.stop: Do not represent the endpoint as physical failure, safety, warranty, or field-pack life.

uncertaintyBudget.control: Require pooled, within-condition, family, and calibration gates simultaneously.
uncertaintyBudget.residual: Forty degrees lies outside the development-temperature range and may activate pathways absent below 25 degrees.
uncertaintyBudget.stop: A pooled accuracy gain cannot override family or calibration failure.

minimalAcademicAdvance: Even if H3 fails, a fully held 40-degree survival table will determine whether early capacity response, broadband EIS response, or pulse response adds any reproducible within-condition information beyond imposed stress and static diagnostics.
safetyEthics: RC54 uses public, previously collected processed battery data. It performs no charging, fabrication, cell opening, personal-data processing, security testing, or operational safety decision.
